# Expected values: GoogleSQL compliance functions_testlib_timestamp.cc,
# GetFunctionTestsLastDay, which agrees with BigQuery's LAST_DAY definition.

SELECT LAST_DAY(d, YEAR) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2001-01-01']) d
=> "2001-12-31"

SELECT LAST_DAY(d, YEAR) FROM UNNEST([DATE '0001-01-01']) d
=> "0001-12-31"

SELECT LAST_DAY(d, YEAR) FROM UNNEST([DATE '9999-11-01']) d
=> "9999-12-31"

SELECT LAST_DAY(d, YEAR) FROM UNNEST([DATETIME '9999-11-01 12:34:56.789123']) d
=> "9999-12-31"

SELECT LAST_DAY(d, QUARTER) FROM UNNEST([DATE '1900-07-31']) d
=> "1900-09-30"

SELECT LAST_DAY(d, QUARTER) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2001-01-01']) d
=> "2001-03-31"

SELECT LAST_DAY(d, QUARTER) FROM UNNEST([DATE '9999-11-01']) d
=> "9999-12-31"

SELECT LAST_DAY(d, QUARTER) FROM UNNEST([DATETIME '1900-10-31 12:34:56.789123']) d
=> "1900-12-31"

SELECT LAST_DAY(d, YEAR) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS DATE)]) d
=> null

SELECT LAST_DAY(d, QUARTER) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS DATETIME)]) d
=> null

SELECT LAST_DAY(d, WEEK) FROM UNNEST([DATE '2001-12-30']) d
